purpose: Define the initial contract between the web interface, API service, local engine, analysis pipeline, and generated reports.
conservative_interpretation: This contract starts the transition from local research pipeline to web platform. It does not mean the application is ready for final users.

layers.responsibility: Execute instance validation, perturbation handling, policy evaluation, comparisons, and C++ tests.
Generate diagnostic reports, ranking reports, experimental design reports, and scientific validation plans.
Expose safe, structured backend operations to the future web interface.
Allow users to configure, run, inspect, and export experiments without using the command line.
Persist instances, perturbations, campaigns, generated artifacts, reports, and user files.
Host the web interface and backend service in a controlled production-like environment.

endpoints.purpose: Return service health and contract version.
Return the latest project status report summary.
Return available generated reports and quality checks.
Return the latest experimental design matrix summary.

initial_pages.purpose: Show engineering status, scientific status, and available reports.
List generated reports and quality checks.
Inspect the planned experimental design matrix.

quality_requirements: The platform contract must be valid JSON.
The web interface must not hide scientific limitations.
Generated reports must remain traceable to quality checks.
Execution endpoints must not be added before an allowlist model exists.
